result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends on where you're based, how many employees you have, and whether you want payroll, tax calculations and employee records all handled automatically.

**My recommendation for most small businesses is Gusto (US businesses) or Xero Payroll (UK businesses).**

Here are the options I'd shortlist.

## Best payroll software compared

![Gusto Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ftD0qJ1yBSoWTtDEs2sOfDQ7-65e7zEzHy-HIAb3bqFrmNGGc0DyUX0E7CdY1ulVg_3Q5_8qLVi4LE1wqaQS_JVEpU9pxbwM6Kz6OYgPCcQM2vYw21WPy-MCNW4IYnmmdNSrLtuLoIyJLYtPy5hO5B7jEV7698TKyyKP6yzFWMR7Sgf2P81H8Y7V-Tx23IPn?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Gusto**

(Best overall – US)

- Automatic payroll and tax filing
- Employee self-service
- Benefits and HR features
- Easy to use for small teams

Indicative pricing: \$49/month + \$6 per employee.

[Gusto website](https://gusto.com/)

---

![Xero – AccountKit Support Center](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/HOFZdHQfaXHdQ0Jl6FhQm1ZL8WDa2JXXY2s_IDNQw6_ClmY--iV2XW1k6Glaj1ICzU7IfOAztiKsPODuDYTSIw6PRmUslgzmZ5aMlPuGROKkGMtSJzGnCUzu5B8zEx6lZO3rd6Y_GILZvoN2_MXkKzeqqLSGOUSO0lv-UiE7fZFfvbCSDizWo5sdMixvhee4?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Xero**

(Best for UK accounting integration)

- Accounting and payroll integration
- Employee payslips
- Payroll reporting
- Useful for businesses already using Xero

[Xero UK website](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![QuickBooks Payroll Workshop Coming up at Landmark - Landmark CPAs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EpjoKgv3qp1QFtZSwa4jOSAGoy_bpW7Sg9OVIiK8-oa8UMuOdZRCQiQ9wIV6A0EP90E_oKZqlgba5b3V-cBIKwbDpfEpoiDXWBpJxyQbp0PrvFWqMD5tYDybAbqob6mWzYEtZyXdxwg9oLN481huockY4Xh7GxIqIqUTHjoFCNUvsU8P9qXqQ0Z3Uur0cFsF?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. QuickBooks Payroll**

- Good accounting integration
- Payroll reporting
- Employee payment management
- Particularly useful for existing QuickBooks customers

[QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/)

---

![AI for Employee Communications | ChangeEngine](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/M8WhEK_asl9rMLsgzwxIQWJzaRdb892_fAnYi8qmQNCv4nj5Z07uFbuHg6prUyIi0qjp0RHtjltbyv8l37F25o2fBFMepkSZ06J5CY6RedIcq1s0vALEvWk78UT3NNj7o4K8YZ_yP-Row6Is2UBPVs3UbSD3JVUoBbMlOmM0Z5cDAi5grUpv-x-LeQ52E6JE?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. ADP**

- Established payroll provider
- HR and employee management
- Useful as the business grows
- More extensive support options

[ADP website](https://www.adp.com/)

---

![Sage Payroll](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YilOgYs9ZP1wfwRzJkFxhA_BlX-p_5FLJTmLkaXii1Zq8iZVEoUFx_wBfKoiVfr0ATGd3JsvVUZhJ3dfKZOkGYm_SBzjjNOitZcJhhfq0Ikj-wTCq4Ucb9ThPMpreJ_oVOHjuM4KTvvryzuP8dhTVsVMgw7AVYaGKaHDYZzKiFaOrf3CUXwlR8gKxA64DoWs?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Sage Payroll**

- Designed for UK payroll requirements
- PAYE and National Insurance calculations
- HMRC reporting
- Payslip management

[Sage UK website](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

These are based on 2026 comparisons and the capabilities of the respective platforms.
